style: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PNG game icon for a cozy Japanese cooking game. Exactly 1024x1024 canvas with genuine transparent alpha background. Hand-drawn Japanese picture-book illustration, flat gouache and colored-pencil texture with light paper grain within the object only, soft wobbly dark-brown outline #2b211b about 3-4% object width. One flat base color plus one darker shadow shape and one small cream highlight. Warm muted palette cream #fff8ec, paper #f6e9d2, red #d7263d, gold #f5b82e, green #3fa66b. Chunky rounded slightly squashed cute shapes. Slight three-quarter top view. Single centered isolated subject fills 80% canvas, even padding. Readable at 48px. No text, letters or numbers, no gradient, gloss, glow, 3D, emoji styling, cast/drop shadows, background tiles or circles. Food has no face.
character: Kuro is the SAME round chubby black cat #1c1c24, never pure black, big round gold-yellow eyes, small pink nose, white chef apron, calm kind a bit sleepy, round bean body stubby limbs. For phrases use upper body, optional chef hat.
